description: Utility object for formatting, detecting, and validating payment card details such as card number, expiry date, and CVC, including brand detection and Luhn checksum validation.

classes.name: PaymentCardUtils.CardBrand
classes.description: Enumeration representing supported card brands, with associated identifiers, display names, and CVC lengths.

classes.name: PaymentCardUtils.Expiry
classes.description: Data class representing a card expiry date with month and two-digit year.

methods.name: digitsOnly
methods.description: Extracts only digits from an input string.

methods.name: detectBrand
methods.description: Detects the card brand based on the starting digits of the card number.

methods.name: formatCardNumber
methods.description: Formats a card number for display, grouping digits according to brand-specific rules.

methods.name: formatExpiry
methods.description: Formats expiry date input as MM/YY as the user types.

methods.name: parseExpiry
methods.description: Parses a formatted or raw expiry date string into a structured Expiry object.

methods.name: isExpiryValidAndNotPast
methods.description: Checks if the expiry date is valid, correctly formatted, and not in the past.

methods.name: luhnValid
methods.description: Validates a card number against the Luhn checksum.

methods.name: last4
methods.description: Retrieves the last four digits of a card number.

methods.name: maxCvcLengthForBrand
methods.description: Returns the expected CVC length for a specific card brand.

methods.name: normalizeZip
methods.description: Normalizes postal code input by trimming and filtering for letters, digits, and common separators.

methods.name: isZipPlausible
methods.description: Checks if the ZIP/postal code input is plausible based on length and content.
